title: Heavy Metal Index — source corpus DOI locator
description: A DOI → source-page map for the Heavy Metal Index corpus: every peer-reviewed and regulatory document with a resolvable DOI that has a live source page, keyed by bare lowercased DOI, with the page slug, public evidence tier, and year. Lets any client resolve a DOI to its record on heavymetalindex.com/sources/{slug}. Document titles are carried in the companion sources.csv.
